name: Chim mia
summary: A small bird of the Tây Sơn cane fields, the color of a dry leaf, eaten in late winter and early spring. It is grilled over charcoal with pepper-lime salt or fried in peanut oil with toasted sesame.
origin: Thị trấn Phú Phong, huyện Tây Sơn.
howToEat: The bird is seasoned with salt, chili, scallion, pepper, a little seasoning powder, and five-spice, then grilled over charcoal or fried in peanut oil. Eat the grill with pepper-lime salt. The fry is finished with toasted sesame.
seoTitle: Chim mia — the small bird at Phu Phong
seoDescription: Chim mía is a small Tây Sơn cane-field bird, grilled with pepper-lime salt or fried with sesame, in late winter and early spring.
